title: Cervical Spine MRI

sections.heading: Purpose
sections.text: This synthetic policy identifies information used to prepare a service request for human review.

sections.heading: Coverage Criteria
sections.text:
- The record identifies the suspected cervical condition and purpose of imaging.
- Non-urgent requests describe symptom duration and conservative management.
- Progressive neurologic findings may require expedited clinical review.

sections.heading: Required Documentation
sections.text:
- Duration and progression of neck or upper-extremity symptoms
- Motor, sensory and reflex examination findings
- Treatments attempted and documented response
- Previous cervical imaging or procedures
- Relevant trauma, infection or malignancy history

sections.heading: Limitations and Exceptions
sections.text:
- Neck pain alone may not provide sufficient case information.
- Claims data cannot replace the clinical examination.
- Final determination requires human review.

sections.heading: Decision Boundary
sections.text: Meeting the listed criteria does not automatically approve the request. Eligibility, benefits, exclusions, clinical context and applicable requirements must be reviewed by an authorized human reviewer.

disclaimer: Synthetic policy created for software demonstration and evaluation. It is not medical or insurance guidance.
